messages:
mira: ran a perf sweep this morning across A10/T4/L4/A100/H100 for continuous batching. seeing weird tradeoffs between max_batch_size and max_tokens_per_batch, want to sync on defaults.

samir: nice — can you paste the top-line numbers? latency p95 and tokens/s by GPU?

mira: p95 gen latency (50 token avg request): A10 82ms, T4 115ms, L4 98ms, A100 36ms, H100 28ms. tokens/s (same mix): A10 2100, T4 1200, L4 1800, A100 8200, H100 9800. these are with max_batch_size=64 and max_tokens_per_batch=4096.

jess: were KV cache hits/misses stable? KV eviction can blow up latency when batches coalesce and cache thrash occurs.

mira: KV hit ratio ~0.92 on average, but on A10/T4 we saw spikes down to 0.6 under aggressive batching bursts. suspect memory pressure + kernel fallback behavior.

kai: kernel selection matters here — for shorter seqs we pick the fused attention kernel on A100/H100 which is very forgiving, on T4/L4 we fall back to the slower tiled kernels for >2048 tokens. that explains some of the tokens/s drop.

anya: interesting — did the profiler show any kernel fallbacks correlated with the stalls?

perf-bot: flamegraph uploaded: https://redwood-internal/prof/1766504321 — top stacks: attention_kernel_fallback -> memcpy -> kv_cache_rehash. heat on small GPUs.

samir: proposal: set conservative defaults per GPU: max_batch_size A10/T4/L4 = 32, A100/H100 = 128; max_tokens_per_batch A10/T4 = 2048, L4 = 3072, A100/H100 = 8192. start there and A/B compare.

jess: +1 but for L4 I'd keep max_batch_size at 48 since we saw better throughput with mid-sized batches and less KV churn. also enable per-request token budget so long tails don't fill the batch.

mira: added config snippet to test branch:
```
continuous_batching:
  per_gpu_defaults:
    T4:
      max_batch_size: 32
      max_tokens_per_batch: 2048
    A10:
      max_batch_size: 32
      max_tokens_per_batch: 2048
    L4:
      max_batch_size: 48
      max_tokens_per_batch: 3072
    A100:
      max_batch_size: 128
      max_tokens_per_batch: 8192
    H100:
      max_batch_size: 128
      max_tokens_per_batch: 8192
  queue_policy: oldest_first
  token_budget_target_pct: 0.75
```

kai: two follow-ups: 1) we should gate H100/A100 higher batch sizes behind kernel capability checks (no fallback to slow kernel), 2) add a KV waterline so we stop accreting when free GPU memory < 12%.

anya: noted a perf regression after the kernel selector change last week — can we replay that run with the new defaults and profiler hooks? I can correlate.

mira: will run replay today on A10/T4 and push results by EOD. samir, jess — want you to review the A100/H100 runs next week.

samir: thanks, please tag me. also let's add a small experiment: fix max_tokens_per_batch across GPUs at 4096 but vary max_batch_size to see which dimension matters more for tail latency. quick AB.

jess: agree. I think tokens-per-batch controls KV pressure more, batch_size controls dispatch costs. separate experiments help isolate.

mira: cool. I'll run matrix: batch_size [16,32,48,64,128] x tokens [2048,3072,4096,8192] on each GPU and attach perf profiles.

perf-bot: test plan created: https://redwood-internal/tests/1766504321. will post results when runs complete. :robot_face:
